review_rationale: Restore only the original Wayfatours Context classification plan and an explicitly invoked local WP-CLI metadata-only reconciliation under existing canonical Site Profile, registry lock and audit controls. The pure bounded preview uses source identity and generation, site/brand binding, original content hash, manifest and registry revision. It rejects mismatched asset counts and cross-company records, and excludes any human-reviewed, incomplete, manual or changed content. The apply operation rederives the entire SHA-pinned plan within the existing registry lock and rechecks review state before writing only classification fields; it never approves, copies content, rescans Google Drive, or creates remote execution rights. Original frozen source and current source both retain independent review history, and positive/negative synthetic PHP 7.4/8.5 scenarios are required.
